record_title: Spectral Floquet reduction for synchronous cycles in row-regular Ricker competition
provenance: An exact local-stability reduction for synchronous periodic orbits of row-regular multispecies Ricker competition maps, motivated by the literature on multispecies coexistence and periodic Ricker dynamics.
limitations: The result is local and applies to the row-regular synchronous sector with common intrinsic growth. It does not establish cycle existence, global attraction, persistence, or stability of nonsynchronous cycles; unit-modulus cases generally require nonlinear analysis.
